title: On the Design Space of Discrete Diffusion Online Adaptation for Molecular Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2607.02834v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Molecular optimization often starts from a pretrained generative model that captures a broad prior over valid molecular structures. At test time, however, the goal is not to sample from this prior, but to use a limited oracle budget to shift generation toward task-specific high-reward molecules. We study this adaptation problem for discrete diffusion models. Each online round couples several choices. The loop must decide which candidates to evaluate, how rewards become model updates, which feedback to reuse, and how far to move beyond the pretrained prior. These choices have mostly been studied in isolation, leaving open whether they complement one another, become redundant, or interfere inside a full online adaptation loop. We conduct controlled studies across six small-molecule binding-affinity tasks and three protein-fitness tasks. translated_title: 论分子优化中离散扩散在线适配的设计空间
translated_abstract: 分子优化通常从一个预训练的生成模型开始，该模型捕捉了有效分子结构上的广泛先验。然而在测试阶段，目标并非从这个先验中采样，而是利用有限的oracle预算，将生成过程转向面向特定任务的高奖励分子。我们针对离散扩散模型研究了这一适配问题。每一轮在线适配都会耦合多个决策：循环必须决定评估哪些候选分子、奖励如何转化为模型更新、复用哪些反馈信息，以及在多大程度上偏离预训练先验。这些选择大多被孤立地研究，留下了悬而未决的问题：它们在完整的在线适配循环中究竟是相互补充、变得冗余，还是相互干扰。我们在六个小分子结合亲和力任务和三个蛋白质适应度任务上开展了对照研究。我们发现，候选获取、奖励塑形与模型去偏置为实现更高（奖励）提供了互补的途径。
tldr: 该论文系统探索了离散扩散模型在分子优化在线适配中的设计空间，通过跨九个任务的对照实验揭示候选获取、奖励塑形与模型去偏置三种机制相互补充、协同提升性能。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically explores the design space of online adaptation for discrete diffusion models in molecular optimization, showing through controlled studies across nine tasks that acquisition, reward shaping, and model debiasing provide complementary routes to higher reward.
